exported_callable_api.secondary_button: pub fn secondary_button(ui: &mut Ui, kind: Icon, label: &str) -> Response -- paints shell/edge/icon/label, publishes WidgetInfo::labeled(WidgetType::Button, ui.is_enabled(), label), returns the Response for the caller to map .clicked() to a Message. States: rest (SURFACE, BORDER, ICON_SECONDARY), hover (HOVER_WASH, NAME_HOVER_BORDER, INDIGO_600), disabled (SURFACE, BORDER, SLATE_300 = the Iced Disabled arm; egui additionally gamma_multiply-fades it by Visuals::disabled_alpha, documented). Geometry: 30px height (BUTTON_HEIGHT), BUTTON_PADDING.left 13pt per side, CONTROL_RADIUS 12, BUTTON_ICON 14 + BUTTON_ICON_GAP 6, BUTTON_TEXT_SIZE 12.
